brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested four Palestinians on Monday while preventing a student graduation ceremony in the Qattanin market in occupied Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. The troops moved into the Old City marketplace to shut down the event, detaining the four individuals during the operation.

The incident reflects ongoing Israeli restrictions on Palestinian gatherings and public events in Jerusalem. The Qattanin market, located in the heart of the Old City, has been a site of frequent Israeli military operations and restrictions on Palestinian activities.
